title: Vanilla Made Better
description: This modpack allows you to be in the Minecraft trailer, while maintaining the vanilla feel. No modded blocks, items or entities.
body:
This modpack allows you to be in the Minecraft trailer, while maintaining the vanilla feel. No modded blocks, items or entities. Resourcepacks like Bare Bones and Fresh Animations, along with every one of their extensions really immerse the MC trailer look. 3 Shaderpacks are included, Complementary Unbound, BSL Classic and Vanilla Plus.

For creative players, there is Axiom, World Edit and Litematica.

For survival players, there are many qol mods, like Tree Harvester and Veinminer.
